title: Netflix Announces Cast for Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Outback
content: Netflix confirmed production on Friday of its new series Outback (working title), with Jun-Yeol Ryu, Kyung Hong, Ho-yeon Jung, Ji-an Won, and Justin H. Min set to star. Based on the webtoon G'day by Yong Sung Choi, Outback follows Sion, who travels to Australia after his older sister's sudden death.
author: ANN

title: 31 Years Ago, This Shoujo Anime Changed The World in a Way You’d Never Expect
content: Just about every anime fan is familiar with shoujo staples like Ai Yazawa’s Nana , or even her slightly more niche hit series Paradise Kiss , but neither of these generation-defining stories would have been made possible without the success of Neighborhood Story .
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Streams Trailer Highlighting "Yoroshiku★Girl" Segment
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a trailer for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story segment of Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque).
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Reveals New Promo Video, Visual
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a new trailer for Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film.
author: ANN

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Anime Film Reveals New Video
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a new video and cast member for Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film. Rie Kugimiya reprises her role as Angela Balzac in the film.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime of 2026 Ends After Just 12 Episodes (With No New Season)
content: Crunchyroll has had to offer a lot of different anime over the past year, but the one genre that has constantly thrived more than the others is no doubt shonen. title: New Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special Reveals Promo Video, Theme Song Artist, Main Visual
content: The staff of Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken (The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30) , the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, revealed a promotional video, the theme song artist, and main visual for the anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Fall in Love, You False Angels' Anime Reveals Promo Video, Cast, Staff
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a new promotional video, two cast members, and three staff members for the 2027 television anime of Coco Uzuki 's Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Sixth Ending Featuring "STAND UP!" by Lead
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixth ending, featuring the song “STAND UP!” by Lead. The song was used in Episodes 64-76, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Bless' Reveals Main Cast, Character Promo, Winter 2027 Debut
content: The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event revealed the main cast, a teaser visual (pictured), and character promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV's NoitaminA programming block at 11.30. p.m. in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
